sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

content.thinking:
The user is asking for an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle and juggling bottles. Create an SVG file with SMIL animation. Anteater: long snout, bushy tail, body. Unicycle: rotating wheel with spokes, pedals. Juggling bottles: three bottles moving along a parabolic arc via animateMotion or keyframe animation.

Let's design a nice SVG, viewBox 800x600. Ground line, anteater on a unicycle, wheel spinning, body bobbing up and down, tail swaying, three bottles being juggled along arcs.

Plan the coordinates:
- Ground y=520.
- Unicycle wheel center (400, 470), radius 50. Spokes rotating with animateTransform rotate.
- Seat post from wheel top to seat (400, 380). Seat at (400, 375).
- Anteater sitting on the seat: body ellipse center (400, 320), legs to pedals. Pedals attached to wheel hub, pedals also rotating. Legs can be somewhat static and bent; simpler: legs pedaling — animate leg rotation around hip.
- Head with long snout pointing left or right, small ears, eyes.
- Big bushy tail behind, sway animation.
- Arms raised holding/juggling bottles.
- Bottles: three, juggled in cascade pattern. Use animateMotion along path arcs between hand positions, staggered start times.

Cascade juggling with 2 hands: bottles arc left hand → right hand → left hand. Simple approach: each bottle follows closed path: from left hand (340,250) arc up to right hand (460,250), then back with lower/straight path? Real cascade: throw from one hand, catch in other, then hand carries... Simplification: each bottle motion path "M340,250 Q400,80 460,250 Q400,300 340,250" duration 1.8s, three bottles with begin offsets 0, 0.6, 1.2. Add rotation via nested animateTransform.

Body bobbing: wrap anteater + arms in a group and animateTransform translate values "0 0; 0 -6; 0 0" dur 0.9s. But wheel/seat stays still; no problem.

Pedaling legs: two legs, each a path from hip (400,350) to pedal. Animate rotate around hip by small angle alternating. Pedals: crank rotating with wheel; draw crank line and two pedal rects in a group rotating around (400,470). Feet won't follow exactly but acceptable stylization. Could sync leg motion using animate on path 'd' morph between two bent-leg poses. Simpler: keep feet near pedals and rock legs.

Let me write clean code:

Anteater colors: grayish brown body #8a7360, dark snout, cream chest band, black band (giant anteater markings: diagonal black/white band on shoulders). Giant anteater: gray body, black diagonal stripe edged white on sides, bushy tail, long snout, small eyes.

Facing left. Head at (330,270), snout tapered to (240,300). Tail big and fluffy behind on right: big feather shape from (450,330) to (560,220), sway rotation ±6° around (450,330).

Arms: front arms raised, hands at (340,245) and (430,240)? Juggling hand positions: left hand (330,240), right hand (450,240). Arms from shoulders (370,300) and (410,300).

Bottle shape: define <g id="bottle"> with rect body, neck, cap; green glass #3f9d5a with highlight. Height ~40. Center at (0,0) so animateMotion works nicely.

Bottle path cascade: left (335,235) to right (455,235) arc apex ~ (395,90). Return path: from right hand back to left low (hand carry) — Q395,270. Each bottle dur 1.8s, begins 0s, -0.6s, -1.2s (negative begin makes all immediately visible). Add rotation spin during flight: animateTransform rotate 0→360 dur 1.8s.

Whole scene slight translate x wobble? Keep unicycle in place with slight rocking rotate ±2 around wheel contact.

Wheel: circle tire dark, rim, spoke group rotating 360 dur 1.2s. Crank group same rotation dur, pedals counter-rotate to stay horizontal: pedals inside crank group have their own rotate -360 same dur around pedal center. Crank arms: line from hub to (400,495) and (400,445) i.e. ±25. Pedals rect at those points, counter rotate around own centers.

Legs: hip (395,345). Leg paths morph d animation between poses matching crank angles at 0°, 180°. Hard to sync exactly; use rotate wobble ±12° dur 1.2s alternating. Fine stylized.

Bobbing: body group translate y 0;-5;0 dur 0.6s (pedal half turn). Hands move with body but bottles paths fixed — small mismatch ok, or put bottle juggles inside bobbing group so hands and bottles bob together. Yes: put bottles inside the anteater group.

Shadow ellipse under wheel, scale pulsing.

Background: sky gradient, sun, clouds drifting, ground. Keep tasteful.

Let me write file anteater-unicycle.svg.

Legs: draw as thick paths stroke-linecap round, stroke #6e5a48 width 14. Front leg from (390,345) Q(380,410) (395,455) with animateTransform rotate values "10 390 345; -10 390 345; 10 390 345" dur 1.2s. Back leg opposite phase, darker color, foot near (405,485). Draw back leg behind wheel? Leg goes to pedal at hub level; draw back leg behind unicycle group, front leg in front.

Order: background, shadow, tail (behind body), back leg, unicycle (wheel+frame), body group (body, head, arms, front leg, bottles), seat maybe under body.

Actually seat post should be behind body. Unicycle frame: line from (400,470) to (400,372), seat ellipse/path at (400,368).

Body: ellipse cx 400 cy 315 rx 55 ry 45, rotated slightly. Chest/neck to head: head circle at (340,265) r 24; snout path from head tapering: M330,255 Q260,270 235,298 Q260,292 335,285 Z — long tapered snout, dark tip. Eye small at (335,258). Ear small circle at (352,246).

Black band: path across shoulder diagonally with white edge — path M365,275 L410,355 ... approximate stripe: polygon (360,272) (385,268) (430,350) (405,358) fill #2b2b2b with white stroke. Keep simple: path with stroke.

Tail: big bushy shape behind: path M445,330 C540,330 580,250 560,190 C545,235 520,240 505,235 C520,270 490,290 445,300 Z fill dark gray #4a4038, sway rotate values "-5 445 320; 6 445 320; -5 445 320" dur 2.4s. Add a few streak lines.

Arms: strokes width 12 color body, from shoulders (375,300) to hand (335,240) slight curve; other (415,300)→(455,238). Paws circles r7 dark at hands. Slight arm wave animate rotate small around shoulder dur 0.9s alternate.

Bottles in same bob group, motion path hands (335,235)→(455,235).

Bottle def:
<g id="bottle">
 <rect x="-8" y="-10" width="16" height="26" rx="4" fill="#2f8f5b"/>
 <rect x="-4" y="-22" width="8" height="14" rx="3" fill="#2f8f5b"/>
 <rect x="-5" y="-26" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#d9a441"/>
 <rect x="-5" y="-6" width="4" height="16" rx="2" fill="#7fd6a4" opacity="0.7"/>
 label rect x-8 y-2 w16 h10 fill #f3e9d2.
</g>

Each use with animateMotion path "M335,238 Q395,70 455,238 Q395,275 335,238" dur 1.8s rotate="0", begins -0s/-0.6s/-1.2s, plus inner g animateTransform rotate 0;360 dur 1.8s (with matching begin offset — nest: outer g has animateMotion, inner use has rotate).

Note: use element referencing g with animateTransform on use works.

Sun with rays rotate, clouds translate back and forth.

    <!-- A juggling bottle, centered at (0,0) -->

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
